text:
Maya (eng): Quick async standup — kicking off a safety sweep for today's rollout. Canary at 3% in eu-west1. Observability smoke looks good so far.

Tom (releases): Nice. Can you paste the feature flag name so I can watch the dashboard?

Maya (eng): flag = feature/redwood-routing-v2. Using staggered slices: 0.5%, 1%, then 3%.

Leo (SRE): Saw a small latency blip on one slice ~10m ago (p90 up ~15%). Not yet correlated to v2. I'm monitoring traces.

Maya (eng): @Leo thanks — can you drop the trace id if you see it? Also I'll hold the next ramp if it looks correlated.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: canary rollout started by Tom. ID: deploy-1960215789. Stages: eu-west1 -> us-central1 (pending). Status: IN_PROGRESS :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jamie (Product): Heads-up that support is on standby for the next hour. If we need to rollback we'll notify customers on the pre-approved channel.

Leo (SRE): Trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. Span shows increased serialization time in runtime-worker-5. Investigating whether it's a model warmup interaction.

Maya (eng): Good catch. I'll roll a tiny test to rehydrate KV cache on worker-5 and watch p90. Running command:```sh
curl -X POST https://internal.ops/reseed?worker=worker-5
```

Tom (releases): Pinged infra to check GPU temp and mem pressure on worker-5.

deploy-bot: Canary stage eu-west1 at 3% — HEALTHY. Metrics: p50=45ms p90=210ms errors=0.6%.

Leo (SRE): After reseed p90 dropped to 135ms on that worker slice. Looks like cache warmup was the culprit.

Maya (eng): OK — proceeding to schedule the us-central1 slice at 1% in 10m. Will pause ramp if we see >1.5x p90 baseline.

Tom (releases): I'll update the rollout sheet and set a 20m hold window after us-central starts.

Jamie (Product): Thanks — I'll be on watch for any user-facing anomalies and stand by for comms. :thumbsup:

Maya (eng): No blockers now. If anyone sees anything odd, @channel call it out and we pause. Short summary for logs: canary-sweep-1960215789 — started 3% eu-west1, recovered from cache warmup, us-central scheduled next.

Tom (releases): Thanks all. Will post final status after us-central slice completes.
